headerDisplay: Log in to Hilo on this settings page. This plugin has its own Hilo login and never uses the token of [homebridge-hilo](https://github.com/SanterreJo/homebridge-hilo), so the two plugins can't sign each other out. homebridge-hilo is not required.

name.title: Name
name.description: Platform name shown in the Homebridge logs.

locationId.title: Location ID (optional)
locationId.description: Only needed if your Hilo account has more than one location. Either the numeric location ID or the URN (urn:hilo:crm:…) shown in the logs. Leave blank to use the account's first location.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often the challenge phase is checked and the state file updated. The challenge schedule itself is fetched from Hilo at most every 5 minutes.
